domains.label: Computer Systems & Engineering
domains.description: Software systems, computer engineering, infrastructure, and applied algorithms
domains.boundary: Classify by contribution to systems or infrastructure. A general computer science match alone is insufficient.

domains.label: AI & Applied Mathematics
domains.description: AI/ML plus computationally relevant optimization, numerical methods, statistics, and scientific ML
domains.boundary: Flag AI and numerical methods as separate subgroups. Require a method contribution to assign the domain when AI is simply applied in another area.

domains.label: Quantitative Finance
domains.description: Mathematical/statistical finance and computational trading, risk, pricing, and forecasting
domains.boundary: Require a financial modeling, pricing, trading, or risk objective. Use a FinTech tag when the work also contributes to digital financial infrastructure.

domains.label: FinTech & Digital Finance
domains.description: Digital financial infrastructure, payments, banking, and crypto/blockchain applications
domains.boundary: Require a financial service or infrastructure use case for general game theory, e-commerce, or blockchain matches.

domains.label: Computational Quantum & Matter
domains.description: Software, algorithms, simulation, and computational optimization for quantum systems and matter
domains.boundary: Track quantum computing, materials simulation, and computational optics separately when entity data are available. Require a computational contribution for broad physics or optics matches.

evaluation.interval_method: 95% circular moving-block bootstrap of annual folds; block length ceil(sqrt(n_folds))

limitations: Query matches overlap and are not independent entity counts
Historical counts are current API snapshots, not vintage data available in the historical year
Only five domains; correlated years and no independent commercialization outcome dataset
Block-bootstrap intervals are descriptive with few annual folds; no significance claim
OpenAlex free-text query matches are broad activity proxies, not validated domain membership
